notes.title: Collision Fixed
notes.notes: Fixed issues with collider. The character falls into the void because not all collision adjustments were working perfectly fine. I checked at all levels.

notes.title: Update action for game info
notes.notes:
I put in the menu screen information about the keys to use in the game (for keyboard and joystick - Remembering that I advise to use the keyboard while I check if everything is ok with the joystick).
It also includes a screen with information about what to do in the game in the levels. Just click the F8 key to open and close a window with information.
I updated now to improve the game experience after guidance from one of the players. I'm learning from you and I'm very happy about it. Please know that I'm still working on finding ways to improve this game.
Thank you very much!

notes.title: My Steampunk Porn Universe
notes.notes:
Hi. I will share the evolution of my project.
It is a game made in Steampunk style. However, there is a certain amount of creative freedom for each element that I am inserting.
I will also show images of what will contain in the game.
It is an independent and individual project. However, I know that I need to show the best I can, even though it's modeled, coded and idealized by one person.
Basically Maya is the software chosen to model most of the models in the game.
Of course there are assets acquired from other developers in the Unity store. Yes, this game is being developed at Unity 2021 and will be available to you soon.

Obviously the most difficult are the sexually explicit animations. I tried to animate most of it. However, in some cases I needed help from animators who are used to animating pornographic content.
